free_tier.stated: reported: a user accumulated more than 2,000 machine-hours of Tencent Cloud Studio credit from a platform bug, with the highest usable shape reported as an L40 GPU, and asked the forum what to do with it.

retention.stated: the 2,000 hours came from a defect and not from the offer, so it is unreproducible by design, and the same thread's earlier reports show the standing grant falling from 50,000 minutes a month in 2024 to 20 to 50 hours in 2026.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: 2,000 L40 hours is about 200 hours of a 10-GPU job, which would be the largest free GPU allowance in the corpus if it were an offer rather than a defect; as a chain element it is a windfall and not a resource.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: no page stating the signup requirement was read; the record's evidence covers the machine-hour grants and the trial-only verdict (a 20 machine-hour pack 'after binding a Tencent Cloud account', 2 machine hours a day on login) but not what that account requires. No evidence row names a phone, a card, an email or an ID document, so the stored any-phone kind is unsupported by this record's own evidence.

evidence.proved: the post, translated: 'earlier Cloud Studio had a bug and I got 2,000-plus machine-hours free, I do not know what to do with them'; the highest configuration available is described as an L40 GPU [re-read 2026-10-22: fetch exit 0, token overlap 0.21; the original capture stands]

the standing offer for comparison, translated: 50 machine-hours on registration and 2 a day for checking in, with replies reporting only 20 [re-read 2026-10-22: fetch exit 0, token overlap 0.0; the original capture stands]

quoted, translated from the vendor's machine-hour FAQ: 'first binding grant: after binding a Tencent Cloud account, a 20 machine-hour resource pack is granted' and 'daily login: after logging in each day, 2 machine hours can be claimed from the profile card (valid for 7 days)'. A new account therefore starts with tens of hours and accumulates at 2 a day, which supports the trial-only verdict and the top of the stored 20-to-50-hour range; it does not support the 2,000-hour windfall, which stays a forum report and is not repeated by any vendor page

notes: Recorded to stop a future session chasing it: the number is real and the route is not. ⚠ A defect grant is not a free tier and must not be counted as one, which is why this is `trial-only` with the defect named in the offer. The useful signal is the trend it sits in: Tencent's standing grant fell by roughly two orders of magnitude between 2024 and 2026 while users kept finding temporary surplus.
